description: Add a list of questions that visitors tap to see the answers, such as shipping, booking or pricing questions, with an optional title. Up to 100 questions. Plain text only. Change it later with update_block faqs (the full list) and rowTitle.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: Shown above the questions, such as "FAQ".

name: add_faq
title: Add an FAQ
